Wow... I see that 40% of you exited the trade early. 

I don't blame you. Every trader has experienced it before... fear.

Fear of missing out. Fear of losing. Fear of failing. Fear of whatever.

Before I take a trade I am already OK with losing the amount I risk. This helps me hold on to trades much more easily and let them play out. If you risk too much you get emotionally involved and are going to act upon these emotions.

Detaching your emotion will decide whether you will be profitable or not.

Plan the trade, trade the plan... leave emotions for other things.
